name: Semantic Model AI Readiness
description: Optimize a Power BI semantic model and prepare it as a Fabric data agent source: run the Best Practice Analyzer, resolve measure dependencies, wire it to a data agent, and evaluate. Covers the reachable steps from Microsoft's 'Semantic model best practices for data agent' guidance.
prerequisites: Authenticated via fabio auth login (or az login) with a SQL-scoped token in the credential chain
An existing Power BI semantic model (or generate one: fabio semantic-model generate --lakehouse ...)
For steps 4-6: a Fabric data agent and F2+ capacity

steps.description: Best Practice Analyzer: flag missing descriptions, cryptic names, implicit aggregation, duplicate measures, ambiguous dates, relationship hygiene, non-star schema, calculated + high-cardinality columns. Fix the issues (descriptions, SummarizeBy=None on keys, star schema).
Optional CI gate: fail (non-zero exit) if any warning/error remains after your fixes.
List each measure's dependent measures/columns/tables so an AI data schema includes ALL required objects (a measure that references other measures needs those too).

steps.command: # Portal step: in Power BI Desktop/Service -> 'Prep data for AI', set the AI data schema, verified answers, and AI instructions (no public REST API; keep model-specific guidance here, NOT at the data-agent level).
steps.description: Prep for AI is portal/Desktop-only. The DAX-generation tool uses ONLY the model metadata + Prep for AI config and ignores data-agent instructions for semantic-model DAX.

steps.command: fabio data-agent add-datasource --workspace $WS_ID --id $AGENT_ID --artifact $SM_ID --artifact-type SemanticModel && fabio data-agent select-tables --workspace $WS_ID --id $AGENT_ID --datasource $SM_ID --all-tables && fabio data-agent publish --workspace $WS_ID --id $AGENT_ID
steps.description: Add the model as a NL2DAX source, select the SAME tables you scoped in Prep for AI, and publish. (Set FABIO_ACCESS_TOKEN from an az Fabric token for the schema-fetch OBO.)

steps.command: fabio data-agent query --workspace $WS_ID --id $AGENT_ID --prompt "What were total sales last quarter?"
steps.description: Test: ask a question and verify the agent returns a correct, grounded answer. (Per-step DAX introspection is not available over the MCP consumption surface; use 'data-agent evaluate' with a question set + expected answers to validate accuracy.)
Evaluate answers against ground-truth question/answer pairs (optional LLM judge) and iterate on the model + Prep for AI config.

steps.command: fabio git connect --workspace $WS_ID ... && fabio deploy apply --source ./items --workspace $PROD_WS
steps.description: Put the model + agent config under source control and promote across dev/test/prod (ALM).

notes: The Prep for AI components (AI data schema, verified answers, AI instructions) are portal-only today. fabio covers everything else: model health (analyze), dependency analysis (measure-dependencies), evaluation (data-agent evaluate), and source control/deployment. See 'fabio context best-practices semantic-model-optimization'.
